subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

I did not like his __bossy__ attitude.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bossy"** means someone who likes to give orders in a domineering or authoritarian manner. (आधिकारिक/हुक्म चलाने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** She can be bossy at times, always telling her teammates what to do.
 
 
 
• **"Controlling"** refers to a person who seeks to dominate or direct the behavior of others, often in a way that is excessive or unwelcome. (नियंत्रण करने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** His controlling behavior made it difficult for others to express their opinions freely.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Idiosyncratic** (अनोखा): Something peculiar or distinctive to an individual.

 
 
• **Example:** His idiosyncratic style of painting makes him stand out in the art community.
 
 
 
• **Sensible** (समझदार): Showing good judgment or practicality.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a sensible decision to carry an umbrella on such a cloudy day.
 
 
 
• **Benevolent** (दयालु): Well-meaning and kindly.
 
 
• **Example:** The benevolent woman donated generously to the orphanage.
